result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but horizontally scrolling content is clipped abruptly at the right edge and the fixed bottom navigation overlaps the visible feed content.

issues.description: The category row ends with an unlabeled partial gray pill at the right edge, making the final category look cut off rather than clearly indicating more horizontally scrollable options.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent right-side padding and/or a clearer scroll affordance so partially visible categories do not appear truncated.

issues.description: The third card in the “Fastest near you” carousel is visibly cut off, including its restaurant name and delivery information, with no trailing gutter at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Provide a trailing margin after the carousel items or use a more deliberate partial-card treatment to communicate horizontal scrolling.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation overlays the next restaurant card in the feed, obscuring a substantial portion of its image in the current view.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the scrollable content has sufficient bottom inset/padding so feed cards can remain fully visible above the fixed navigation bar.
